title.zh: GPT 6.1 Sol: Near-Astra intelligence for a fifth of the price
title.en: GPT 6.1 Sol: Near-Astra intelligence for a fifth of the price

current_state.zh: OpenAI introduced GPT-6.1 Sol, marketed as near-Astra intelligence at roughly a fifth of the cost, alongside cheaper cached input pricing and a restructured subscription lineup including a new $500/month Pro 500 tier and reduced allowances on the existing $200 Pro plan.
